description: Create a merchant-owned Workroom approval request for a customer-facing send. The agent must not call send_message, send_whatsapp_message, send_test_campaign, or send_campaign directly.

actionType.description: The customer-facing action to execute only after merchant approval

agentId.description: AI colleague ID that is a participant in the thread

payload.description: Exact tool payload to execute if the merchant approves. For send_test_campaign use { campaignId, to }, with an email address or international WhatsApp number matching the campaign channel.

summary.description: Human-readable draft/recipient/campaign summary shown above the approval buttons

threadId.description: Workroom thread ID where the approval button should appear

name: request_send_approval

data.description: Tool result payload — shape varies per tool, see the tool description

renderType.description: UI rendering hint for the result

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary of the action
